hero.oneLiner: Basilic Fly Studio positions itself as a globally integrated VFX studio combining award-winning UK/Europe creative leadership with India-led, cost-efficient production execution to build a scalable global delivery platform.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Globally integrated VFX company delivering premium visual effects across feature films, episodic content, streaming platforms and emerging visual media, with operations in India, the UK, France and Canada.
- August 2024 acquisition of a majority stake in BAFTA and Emmy-winning One of Us strengthened the Group's creative leadership, premium client portfolio and direct access to UK/European markets.
- Hybrid Global Delivery Model combines overseas client proximity (UK/Europe creative leadership) with India-led cost-efficient execution, creating a cost + delivery moat difficult for pure domestic or pure overseas studios to replicate.
- Diversified client engagement across direct client relationships and sub-contracting arrangements reduces reliance on any single revenue model.
- Trusted Partner Network certification and the TPN Stella Award (only the 6th VFX studio globally) underline security/reliability credentials that support trust with major studios and streamers.
- Ongoing rationalisation of the global VFX industry is framed as an opportunity for well-capitalised, independent studios like Basilic Fly to gain market share and deepen client relationships.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Leadership] Strengthened global leadership bench with senior hires including Adrian De Wet and Audrey Ferrara (VFX), Marianne Speight (LA) and Theresa Patten-Koeckert (London), plus creative supervision from Abishek Nair (UK); Q1-FY27 additions include VFX Supervisors Stuart Lashley (Aquaman, Fast & Furious, Black Panther) and Sebastin (The Martian, Avengers: Infinity War, AI-integrated VFX workflows), Senior BD Manager Ameya Samant, CG Supervisor Ajit Nair, and 2D Supervisor/Pune Head Venugopal.
- [Workforce] Talent development boot camps in Chennai and Pune, AI upskilling for artists/production teams, and university partnerships (Saveetha, SRM Ramapuram) are building a future-ready internal talent pipeline and reducing dependency on external hiring.
- [Marquee Work] Q1-FY27 and FY25-26 marquee deliveries include Glory (Netflix), Lupin Series 4 (Netflix), The Walking Dead S4, an unreleased AMC horror series, Troll 2, F1: The Movie, Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man, Stranger Things Season 5, Mission Impossible: The Final Reckoning, Bungonia and The Witcher: Season 4.
